items.title: Bill Easley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 1, 2021
items.q: And with guys I didn’t really know that well. I brought in a ringer from New York, an organ player by the name of Kyle Kohler.

ctx.x: I’m wondering if you have anything to say about the state of our country. Because you are an observer of human nature, and you were just talking about extremes. Do you have anything you can comment on?

Well my current mission man, my current thought and my current project, and it’s more, I’ve got a record coming out in April. I did it here locally in Durham you know. And with guys I didn’t really know that well. I brought in a ringer from New York, an organ player by the name of Kyle Kohler. ‘Cause I played with all of the great organ players. I probably played with more great organ player than anybody on the planet. Jimmy Smith, Jimmy McGriff, you can’t name but maybe two organ players that I didn’t play with.…

Because we are and that’s a fact of life. Man, we’re all different and you know we should just respect each other for our differences and naturally we don’t have to all agree but we have to respect each other or else we’re headed toward self-destruction. The fact is simple. It’s simple. You know the best way to get some respect is to die, and then everybody be [groans] everybody is interested in you then. But no, respect the living you know, because it’s important and we’d have such a better, better world and you…
